name: EvoDeFi MasterChef updatePower raises power without settling rewardDebt
summary: MasterChef.updatePower(pid) is public and recomputes user.power from the staked amount and the caller's current NFT/proxy bonus without paying pending rewards or resetting rewardDebt. A staker whose bonus rises can call updatePower and the next claim pays the new power times the whole accumulated reward per power minus the old debt. The first exercise (April 2021, a staker whose bonus rose 9%) paid about 0.0039 GEN extra; on 2021-06-10 an attacker flash-borrowed GEN, and six helper contracts each deposited, raised their NFT bonus, called updatePower and withdrew, draining 456,262 GEN from the MasterChef.
notes: Immutable MasterChef runtime; the proxy (bonus source) was set in the constructor and setProxy was never called; pool add/set and emission updates do not touch updatePower.

Net GEN depletion of the MasterChef in the 2021-06-10 transaction source-2 (other stakers' deposits and reward reserves). Valued at the attacker's realised sale price: 455,576.854326181275474802 GEN sold in 21 transactions (blocks 8169292..8169627) returned 334,616.733764492976012720 BUSD from the GEN/BUSD pair and 421.633957188326703176 WBNB from the GEN/WBNB pair (WBNB at 365.646 USD), about 1.07 USD per GEN; the sale drove GEN from about 2.1 USD down, so this is a lower bound (reported loss about 1,000,000 USD). The April anchor sequence paid about 0.0039 GEN of unearned reward (source-9), which is not added.
